name: herdr-remote-monorepo
description: Monorepo for herdr-remote (Herdr plugin + TUI) and herdr-remote-relay (standalone relay)

scripts.build: npm run build -w herdr-remote-relay && npm run build -w herdr-remote
scripts.test: npm run test -w herdr-remote-relay && npm run test -w herdr-remote
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w herdr-remote-web && npm run typecheck -w herdr-remote
